title: Cymbopogon nardus essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Cymbopogon nardus essential oil is a fragrant, yellowish oil derived from the leaves of the lemongrass plant, which is native to tropical regions. It is widely used in herbalism for its calming and antiseptic properties. This essential oil is often employed to alleviate stress, anxiety, and insomnia due to its soothing effects on the nervous system. It can also be applied topically to treat skin conditions and reduce inflammation. In aromatherapy, it is used to promote relaxation and enhance mental clarity.
